dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (レセプト) processing system - receipt count/page summary print component
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It generates a printed summary report of receipt counts and page counts by insurance type (社保, 国保, special fees, self-pay, unknown). It iterates over insurance category tables from a shared SPA area and writes formatted output to a print file via the ORCSMKPRT subprogram.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA (shared parameter area)
Multiple COPY statements for shared includes (12 total)
Shell script reference (HC01.sh) for print generation
Japanese text in comments and literals (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
PERFORM VARYING with nested loops over insurance category tables
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Fixed-format source with revision history comments
verdict.notes: Source contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded here as latin-1 causing mojibake in display. File is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Truncated at 16000 chars but the main logic is visible. The 31012-SEIWA-HEN-SEC (Western calendar to Japanese era conversion) section body is cut off.
